messages.subject: Question
messages.body: R860 source audit: official6c required unitrace --result-dir calls CreateConfigLog/StringifyDevice/zeInit before later SetEnv of UNITRACE_LD_PRELOAD_OLD, ZE_ENABLE_TRACING_LAYER, ZES_ENABLE_SYSMAN and LD_PRELOAD, then execvp replaces the image. Native image starts with a fully fixed environment, and I preset CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER to avoid generate.cpp main-entry setenv after collector initialization, but the CLI launcher itself mutates env after its Level Zero metadata probe. Does your explicit pinned-CLI instruction authorize this pre-exec launcher behavior, or must I deliver a hard source blocker under the process-environment immutability rule? Controller, gates and report are prepared; no execution or product edits occurred.

messages.subject: R861 source-only softmax proposal ready
messages.body: Created the source-only R861 package with the complete patch, frozen base and candidate SHA256s, provenance, sparse oracle extensions and a finite Main qualification plan. The opt-in covers FP32 and BF16 while preserving the default softmax and oracle bodies, with the distinct scale, infinity and NaN contracts retained in source and FP32 reduction-order differences disclosed. Builds, tests, GPU work, profilers, model quality and physical-context validation remain UNRUN, and Main must review and decide application after its active jobs close.
